name: CLAIM -> SOURCE TRACE -> EXECUTION EVIDENCE -> REPRODUCTION
question: Was this claim ever computed by the code it cites, and can the number be re-derived from preserved inputs?

steps.does: intake: does the claim name a referent that resolves in the tree (path#token)?
who imports / mentions the cited instrument; zero external consumers = the number was never consumed
git history of the instrument around the claim date; recover the bytes that existed THEN, not now
for boolean / exact claims: truth-table oracle; NT-011 z3 via NT-057 redirect for satisfiability claims
for forecast / calibration claims: declared-vs-reported audit against an external ledger
when the claim cites a database row: read-only probe with identity check (HITL for the connection)

output_contract: {referent_resolves, n_external_consumers, bytes_at_claim_date_sha256, reproduced: YES/NO/NOT_ATTEMPTED, reproduction_inputs_fingerprint}; 'reproduced' may only be YES when the inputs are the historical inputs (charter XIII)
